items.title: 🕐 Fall Back!
body: Remember to turn back your clock before bed Saturday night! We fall back for daylight saving time.

link.label: Read the Article by Pastor Waring

items.title: Samaritan’s Purse
body: Let’s overflow the collection totes for Samaritan’s Purse this week — fill them up! This is a great project to involve your children: take them to the store, let them help choose toys or gifts, teach them about the project, and let them place the donations in the baskets.

items.title: Every Member Canvass
body: Does your giving — of your time, talents, and treasures — look increasingly like how Jesus gave? Consider and respond to the EMC online, or by paper booklet at each entrance and in the office!
items.note: If you had trouble submitting online, try it again. We removed the country area code requirement that might have been giving you trouble!

sections.intro: with those around you! Encouragement from Bobby Capps:

quote.text: You are the light of the world.

body: Light does not have to call attention to itself to be useful; it simply has to be present. Ask God to help you notice the person already in front of you.

quote.text: Look not only to his own interests, but also to the interests of others.

body: Care starts with attention. Before we can help someone, we have to notice them.

Yarn Crafters makes hats and scarves for the warming center; hats, booties, and blankets for Oasis Medical Center; as well as layettes for newborns in the church body. We knit, crochet, and use a loom to create our goodies.
We have a multitude of projects and very few crafters. If you want to learn to knit or crochet, our experts are available to teach you!

image.alt: Hand-knit baby hats and booties by Yarn Crafters

items.note: *Meetings:* Tuesdays at 1:00 p.m. at Nancy Nunley’s house, 411 E. Fourth St. Call Janet Winders at 901-275-0765 for more information.

items.title: 37th Community Thanksgiving Meal
body: Join us on Thanksgiving morning as we prepare and deliver 750 Thanksgiving meals to those who need it throughout Alcorn County. This is a HUGE project and can only be accomplished with the help of many. This is a great opportunity for the members of FPC to be disciples by “living and loving like Jesus.” You can help with meal prep or by delivering meals.
items.note: Please fill out the insert at church Sunday to volunteer your time, and place it in the offering plate or drop it by the church office.

items.title: America’s Providential History
body: A new Sunday school class entitled “America’s Providential History” will begin Sunday, November 1. It will be a 6-month class led by Richard Hendrick. Please call the church office to register; the cost of the book is $25.

items.title: 🗳️ Election Day
body: Reminder to exercise your right to vote Tuesday, November 3! Our FPC Fellowship Hall is a voting precinct, and the polls will be open on Tuesday.

items.title: Kids Quest Family Gathering
body: Kids will sing a couple of songs at 5:00, and parents will pick up from the pavilion area as we welcome all our Kids Quest families on the campus!
A big thank-you to Dave Shanklin for coming last week and singing a fun song with the kids!

image.alt: Dave Shanklin playing guitar for the kids

items.title: Memory Work
body: We will have one more round of memory work before the end of the year. Get a sheet and put the verses somewhere you’ll see them every day. Visit the table on Sunday mornings during breakfast to recite your verse and get candy. Adults, kids, everyone is welcome!

link.label: Get the New Memory Work Sheet

items.title: YH ‘Friendsgiving’ Progressive Dinner
body: Contact Jennifer if you’d like to host!
Randy Long is teaching Sunday School for the month of November.

sections.intro: Lots of chances to be involved! Jump in somewhere!

items.title: First Thursday
body: Sally Beth McCullough will be speaking on adoption. Please come, bring a lunch, bring a friend, and join us!

items.title: WM Book Club
body: Join us as we discuss *Theo of Golden* by Allen Levi and *Murder in the Choir Loft* by Michael Allen Adam. Read along and jump in!

items.title: Serve: Tabitha’s Toolbox
body: Tabitha’s Toolbox work day is Saturday, November 7! Join the GroupMe for all the details.

items.title: Serve: Martha’s Ministry
body: Martha’s Ministry cooking team is restocking the freezer meals soon. If you’d like to lend a hand in cooking, please reach out to Nancy Palmer at 662-415-1608 for the details.
